tests: virtio_gpu_display_info_contiguous_fenced: 408-byte response, enabled 1280x800 mode, fence flag/id echo, used-ring publication
virtio_gpu_display_info_split_header_unfenced: two readable 12-byte descriptors parse as one header; response fence flag/id are zero
virtio_gpu_display_info_short_tail_is_bounded: 32-byte writable tail truncates safely and leaves the following sentinel untouched

coverage: VirtioDevice::queue_notify marks deferred work while the MMIO bus is borrowed.
The control queue is built from the existing split-virtqueue engine and drains the used ring after each request.
Headers are copied through readable descriptors without assuming descriptor boundaries; responses are copied only through validated writable descriptors.
Fence responses retain FLAG_FENCE and fence_id only when requested, while preserving ctx_id/ring_idx and zeroing response padding.
The short-tail test verifies no write escapes the provided writable descriptor.
scope_notes: Unsupported-command error responses and malformed-chain policy remain owned by E5-T01c.
No independent-machine or WebKit run was used, per the user's direction.
